title: 5-day maritime defense drill set for eastern Mindanao seaboard

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), through the Eastern Mindanao Command (EastMinCom), will mount Exercise Surigao Sentinel 2026 from October 20 to 25 across Surigao City and Dinagat Islands, marking a pioneering territorial defense drill on the country’s eastern seaboard and the first of its kind in the Caraga region. For years, the country’s maritime defense concerns have centered mostly on the West Philippine Sea, which China is claiming as part of the South China Sea.
